title: Lessons for Young and Not-so-young Couples
primary_topics: Remarks at the online Diamond (60th) Wedding Anniversary Mass of CJP and Leni on April 8, 2021 -- the anniversary date itself, just one day after returning from a joyful Singapore trip, two years before Leni's death
Three lessons for married couples: (1) Talk it over; (2) Pray together every evening; (3) Trust the Lord always

The COVID pivot: the Vatican Plan A (Cardinal Tagle celebrating Mass) and Manila Cathedral Plan B both made impossible by the March 29-April 11 ECQ; unplanned Plan X (online family-only Zoom Mass) becomes the actual celebration
Proposal for an annual family reunion every January 1 at 10:00 AM Manila time, replacing the grand anniversary plan with a sustainable tradition
sub_topics: The 'two unbendable Rules': Rule 1: My wife is always right. Rule 2: Always follow Rule 1. -- followed immediately by Leni's comic inversion: 'Thank you for agreeing with me. But I think we should do it your way.'

Lesson 1 -- Talk it over: when major disputes arise, talk the matter over, consult elders, priests, doctors, trusted friends; if no solution, 'talk it over again and again until a solution is reached'

Lesson 2 -- Pray together every evening: daily habit of holding hands and praying on their knees at a home altar or in bed; extemporaneous prayers in English, Tagalog or Capampangan; 'you will not let a quarrel last more than a day' because evening prayer dissolves the day's sulking

Lesson 3 -- Trust the Lord always: He may not remove obstacles but gives strength to overcome them; 'for every unexpected turn of events, for every disappointment... is always a silver lining, an unbeknownst goodness'

The Vatican Plan A: two years of planning; Cardinal Chito Tagle had reserved it in his calendar; prospective ninong/ninang: Archbishop Soc Villegas, Monsi Gerry, Ambassador Tita de Villa, Mrs. Bai Delos Reyes -- all agreed to fly to Rome; hotels and church reserved

Plan B: Manila Cathedral; Ambassador Tita texted that it would be 'symbolic of the love needed by marriage to be restored to its original beauty' -- a new space inside the Cathedral grounds recently built
Plan X: daughter Len in charge; 'unplanned Plan X which we are holding now' -- online Eucharistic Celebration, family members only

The silver lining in Plan X: 'He wanted us -- close family relatives who have not met, spoken or greeted one another for a long, long time -- to hear Mass together and exchange greetings and kumustahan'
Monsignor Gerry Santos introduced: met in the mid-1980s; catechized CJP in Catholic theology; calls CJP 'Tay,' Leni 'Nay,' CJP calls him 'Anak'; officiated weddings of Len/Alex and Mig/Echel
Annual reunion proposal: January 1, 2022 at 10:00 AM Manila time; 'Len will make the necessary arrangements' -- a Plan X legacy turned into a tradition
Notes on previous diamond anniversary plans vs. what actually happened: two-year planning cycle crashed by COVID-19 ECQ March 29-April 11, 2021 (restricting religious gatherings to <10 persons)

stances.claim: The three lessons (talk it over, pray together every evening, trust the Lord always) are not romantic platitudes but crisis-tested practices: 60 years of ups and downs, including the COVID pivot from Vatican to Manila Cathedral to online-only, validate them as reliable guides.
stances.rhetorical_move: experiential-validation argument: the three lessons are presented as tested over 60 years, not as ideals

stances.claim: The COVID Plan X -- an unplanned, family-only online Zoom Mass -- turned out to be the Lord's own design: 'He wanted us -- close family relatives who have not met, spoken or greeted one another for a long, long time -- to hear Mass together and exchange greetings and kumustahan.' Every thwarted plan has a silver lining that is the Lord's actual intent.
stances.rhetorical_move: providential-reframing: the failed plans are not failures but divine redirection to the superior outcome

stances.claim: Daily evening prayer together is the most practical marital peace-keeping mechanism: 'you will not let a quarrel last more than a day because in the evening you would be holding hands and praying together' -- making the sunset the structural deadline for the resolution of any daily tension.
stances.rhetorical_move: sunset-as-structural-deadline: extemporaneous evening prayer as the enforced reconciliation mechanism

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered April 8, 2021 at the online Diamond Wedding Anniversary Mass of CJP and Leni via Zoom -- two years before Leni's April 9, 2023 death -- this speech opens by greeting the extended family worldwide and thanking Monsignor Gerry Santos ('Anak' to CJP's 'Tay' and Leni's 'Nay') for presiding. CJP offers three lessons to young and not-so-young married couples derived from 60 years of marriage: (1) Talk it over -- when major disputes arise, consult elders, priests, doctors and friends; if no solution, talk it over again and again; (2) Pray together every evening -- hold hands and pray extemporaneously (in English, Tagalog or Capampangan) at the home altar or in bed before sleeping, using the sunset as the structural deadline that prevents quarrels from lasting more than a day; and (3) Trust the Lord always -- He may not remove obstacles but grants the strength to overcome them, and every thwarted plan has a silver lining that is His actual intent. He narrates the three-plan pivot: Plan A was a Vatican Mass with Cardinal Tagle celebrating and Archbishop Villegas, Monsi Gerry, Ambassador Tita de Villa, and Ninang Bai all agreeing to fly to Rome -- two years of planning destroyed by the ECQ; Plan B was Manila Cathedral (Ambassador Tita texted that it would be 'symbolic of the love needed by marriage to be restored to its original beauty'); Plan X is the unplanned online family-only celebration happening right now. Mid-speech, CJP realizes the Lord's actual purpose: 'He wanted us -- close family relatives who have not met, spoken or greeted one another for a long, long time -- to hear Mass together and exchange greetings and kumustahan.' He converts the COVID improvisation into a tradition: annual family reunion every January 1 at 10:00 AM Manila time, with Len handling arrangements.
